status: frozen before any evidence run (freeze commit recorded in the worklog); amendments only as labelled appended entries
batch_class: suffix batch WL93C (user brief 2026-11-13): continues the WL93 / WL93A / WL93B local-operator question on the tied operator with supervision changes only; WL93 STOPPED-INCONCLUSIVE (Amendment 1 pending), WL93A NO_SIGNAL_AT_SMOKE_SCALE and WL93B SHARING_SIGNAL are preserved and not reinterpreted
question: Can ECRO's physically shared local operator learn accurate source and receiver responses simultaneously under direct stage supervision, and does that reduce the integrated transport regression observed in WL93A?

hypothesis.H_DUAL: explicit physical supervision at both local uses lets a tied operator keep source-stage fidelity while reducing the whole-transport regression caused by source-only supervision

inspection_disclosure: WL93A T0 / TQ and WL93B U0 / UQ / C0 / CQ results were inspected before this protocol (incl. the exact-local floor 0.0998 of the receiver use on the physical first flight vs t2, WL93B account); the oracle composition below and TR / TQR have never been evaluated on this population (WL92B evaluated X_M12 on E2 / E4 tables only)
invariants: ECRO / model86 generator, frozen ER, deployed 16-sample source encoding, local rank 16, widths, tied source / receiver factors (model93.Local mode tied), global branch frozen to WL92A own_s<seed> (identical, tested), geometry / lighting interfaces, WL92A split, WL93A training subset / targets / references / optimisation; no runtime oracle in any trained arm
physical_local_operator: M64 = quad87 dense frozen-ER bin matrix Mq[material] (diag92.local_matrices, flat patch frame; sphere patches use the flat-frame matrix as WL87 declared); exact local use on an incident field E [N, bi, 3]: out[i, bo] = sum_bi E[i, bi] M64[m_i, bi, bo]; flight = the deployed state-ray gather with the model's fixed ray weights rw (identical in every arm)

task_a_oracle.construction: ORA_s = M64( flight( M64(s16) ) ) + G_s: the exact physical local operator at BOTH uses of the single flight on the deployed encoding, plus the frozen learned global term of WL92A own_s<seed> (non-deployable diagnostic, no learning)

attribution_variants.ORA_SRC_s: exact source use, T0_s learned receiver use
attribution_variants.ORA_RCV_s: T0_s learned source use, exact receiver use on its own first flight
attribution_variants.ORA_PHYS_s: exact receiver use on the first flight of the physical once-scattered field (B5 mean) + G_s (physical source, no encoding)

task_a_oracle.evaluation: WL93B accounting on validation (55 x 4, g00010 included; primary), train-representative and E2: source stage vs B5, receiver use on the physical first flight vs t2 (exact by construction for ORA), single vs t2, whole vs t, global vs t - t2, signed level errors of single and global (compensation reading); renders of ORA_s on E2 T0 / T1, E5k995 T0 / T1, E1 T1 LSPOT (2 x 4,096 spp, seeds 86600 / 86601)
task_a_oracle.gate_ORACLE_FEASIBLE: for BOTH seeds: WHOLE(ORA_s) <= WHOLE(TQ_s) - max(margin_WHOLE, 0.5 gap_s) AND SINGLE(ORA_s) <= SINGLE(TQ_s) - margin_SINGLE, with gap_s = WHOLE(TQ_s) - WHOLE(T0_s) and margin = 2 SE of the paired geometry bootstrap (2,000 resamples, seed 93003). If the gate fails: verdict ORACLE_COMPOSITION_LIMITED, no training
task_a_oracle.limiting_factor_mapping: (reported in every case, both seeds) LOCAL_OPERATOR if SINGLE(ORA_s) > SINGLE(T0_s) - margin_SINGLE (the exact composition is not a more accurate single flight than the learned tied operator); GLOBAL_COMPENSATION if SINGLE(ORA_s) <= SINGLE(T0_s) - margin_SINGLE but WHOLE(ORA_s) > WHOLE(T0_s) - margin_WHOLE (a better single flight does not carry into the whole because the frozen global term was co-trained with the learned single flight); otherwise NOT_LIMITING; per-seed labels, INTERACTION if the seeds disagree

task_b_training.objective: OWN + w_q l_q + w_r l_r; l_q = WL93 source-stage loss mean(((Bq - q)/den(q))^2); l_r = mean(((R_theta - R*)/den(R*))^2) with R_theta = a (c flight(q)) (the tied operator's receiver use on the physical first flight of the training target q) and R* = M64(flight(q)) (the physically correct receiver response to the same first flight); den(x) = x.mean(bins) + 0.05 x.mean(all) (the WL93 normalisation); weights fixed now, never tuned
task_b_training.training: WL93A contract unchanged: 128-geometry subset, WL93A B0 training targets q (seeds 93.5M range), 2,000 steps, lr 3e-4 -> 1e-5 cosine after 200 warmup, clip 10, order rng(seed + 93), seeds 8601 / 8602, init WL92A own_s<seed>

task_b_criteria.notation: per seed s; SRC / RECV / SINGLE / WHOLE = validation pooled relative L1 (source stage vs B5 mean; receiver use on the physical B5 first flight vs t2; single vs t2; whole vs t); gain_s = SRC(T0) - SRC(TQ); gap_s = WHOLE(TQ) - WHOLE(T0); margin = 2 SE (paired geometry bootstrap, seed 93003) - training is deterministic on this path (WL93B: retrained = WL93A to every digit)
task_b_criteria.a_source_preserved: SRC(TQR) <= SRC(T0) - 0.5 gain_s AND SRC(TQR) <= SRC(TQ) + margin_SRC
task_b_criteria.r_receiver_improved: RECV(TQR) <= RECV(T0) - margin_RECV AND RECV(TQR) <= RECV(TQ) - margin_RECV
task_b_criteria.b_whole_vs_TQ: WHOLE(TQR) <= WHOLE(TQ) - max(margin_WHOLE, 0.5 gap_s) AND SINGLE(TQR) <= SINGLE(TQ) + margin_SINGLE
task_b_criteria.s_no_sharp_regression: renders: region-C E_H(TQR) <= 1.25 x E_H(TQ) + 0.002 on E2 T0 / T1 and E5k995 T0 / T1; stationary and D E_H <= 1.25 x T0 + 0.002 on those and E1 LSPOT; no WL86 gate passed by T0 lost
task_b_criteria.DUAL_SUPERVISION_SIGNAL: a, r, b, s for both seeds
task_b_criteria.STAGE_ONLY_IMPROVEMENT: a and r for both seeds, but b or s fails for at least one seed
task_b_criteria.NO_SIGNAL_AT_SMOKE_SCALE: r fails for both seeds, or (a fails for both seeds and b fails for both seeds)
task_b_criteria.INCONCLUSIVE: any other combination or a control / test failure
task_b_criteria.descriptive_contrasts: TQ vs T0, TR vs T0, TQR vs TQ, TQR vs TR with the same margins; not additive shares

tests.T_REUSE: WL93A T0 / TQ load with their recorded state hashes
tests.T_FLIGHT: flight(rw, gs, Bq) equals the first flight inside model93.Local.single (exact)
tests.T_ORACLE: ORA_s on E2 T1 equals the WL92B X_M12 counterfactual of own_s<seed> (CF_E2_T1.npz; <= 1e-5 relative)
tests.T_RECV_TARGET: R* is linear (scaling / superposition <= 1e-5), non-negative, zero -> zero, built from q (not from the model's first flight; changing the model leaves R* unchanged), and its correspondence to the path-traced 2-event field is reported (M64 flight(D q) vs t2 on E2 T1)
tests.T_TIED: c_s is c_r for every arm
tests.T_INIT: every arm equals WL92A own on E2 T1 at step 0 (<= 1e-5); T0 / TQ / TR / TQR initial state dicts identical
tests.T_TARGETS: training-target seeds disjoint from the B5 evaluation-reference seeds; train / validation geometry content disjoint

renders.models: ORA_s (Task A); T0 / TQ / TR / TQR x seeds (Task B, if run)

scope: smoke scale; inspected conditions only; no untied factors, no architecture / encoding / rank change, no global training, no weight tuning, no full-scale training, no new held-out suite, no successor
